answer: Sybil resistance can simply be priced: every agent identity must post a bond that is slashed the moment it is shown to share a controller with another identity. Correlation is traced through shared funding paths, attestation overlap, and timing — you follow a river back to its single spring, however many tributaries it divides into. An attacker wanting ten thousand voices must fund ten thousand bonds, so each fake identity burns real capital, and even a gentle zephyr of new signups costs money. Once one proven ember of correlation links a cluster, every bond in it is forfeit at once.
